## Earlier upstream evidence retained by reference

### Frozen HFT

The pinned source records the dual-XGMII pre-hardware system, protocol/session/replay closure and simulation-derived latency baseline. Its claims remain upstream claims at the pinned SHA; this integration repo does not rewrite their evidence level.

### Frozen RMIC

The pinned source records M5.4 functional regressions and U50 post-route closure for the standalone dual-flow risk core. Those results establish feasibility of the frozen core, not timing closure of the final combined HFT+RMIC top.

## Integration history notes

- I2 futures accounting remains a deterministic host-configured risk-budget model, not TAIFEX SPAN.
- Frozen HFT report sequence ownership remains authoritative for R02/R32 commit/de-dup/gap handling.
- I2 state ownership is fail-closed after reset and requires explicit recovery/configuration.
- The futures order-context payload fits inside the frozen 96-bit AMU value.
- The first real-AMU I2 route failed setup at WNS `-6.866 ns`; structural pipelining moved synthesis WNS to `+2.318 ns` and routed WNS to `+1.078 ns` without multicycle exceptions or clock relaxation.
- The repaired routed critical path is in the frozen AMU BRAM candidate-selection path, not futures state/margin logic.
- The junior U50/network archive remains a selective migration candidate and does not change the current HFT source pin.
